blockers.what: The own-PR lookup reads at most 20 open PRs whose head branch NAME is chore/feed-snapshot-auto and filters forks client-side. On a public repository, 20 or more fork PRs from a same-named branch can push the agent's own open PR out of the list. Then mine is null, facts.previousPr is set to NOT_OPEN, gh pr create fails ('already exists'), and withSince drops the still-open waiting PR from snapshot-pr.json, the record and --status. (tools/feed/snapshot-pr.mjs:398-420 (with withSince at :125), found by the `unit` tier)

A PR opened in this step can be lost on a stop. onSignal kills child groups, waits 2 s, then writes signalRecord from the snapshot-pr.json on disk and calls process.exit. If gh pr create has already succeeded and the following gh pr merge child outlives SIGTERM for the full grace, or its close event is processed after the timer, the new PR number never reaches the record or snapshot-pr.json. (tools/feed-job.mjs:524-533 with tools/feed/snapshot-pr.mjs:431-445, found by the `unit` tier)

readServedFeed is not bounded by the step's deadline: it uses readServed's own 20 s timeout. The worst case ends about 5 s before the watchdog (a child started with just over 1 s left, plus 5 s kill grace, plus 20 s fetch, set against the 30 s slack). It is inside the watchdog today only because of that slack. (tools/feed/snapshot-pr.mjs:305 and tools/feed-job.mjs:409, found by the `unit` tier)

mainCarries drops the recorded PR even when it is still open. For example, a person committed the snapshot by hand while the agent's PR still waited, possibly with auto-merge requested. The obsolete PR stays open on GitHub and disappears from --status. (tools/feed/snapshot-pr.mjs:279-282 and :125, found by the `unit` tier)

When the own PR's head is not the commit just pushed after 3 reads, and no earlier step recorded that PR, the step fails with the PR number only in `reason`. facts.pr is not set, so --status names no PR. (tools/feed/snapshot-pr.mjs:421-426, found by the `unit` tier)

The record's readers that alert do not read the new state. A PR that waits for a person produces outcome published, consecutiveFailures 0 and a fresh lastPublished, so the host rule in AGENTS.md (two failures in a row, or lastPublished older than 26 h) stays silent; only a person who runs `node tools/install-feed-agent.mjs --status` sees it, and GitHub sends no notice for one's own PR. On this repository every proposal ends auto-merge-unavailable. Records written by the bootstrap or the launch line (fail, signalRecord, crashRecord, the printf) do not carry snapshotPr either, though --status still reads snapshot-pr.json. (the status record's alerting reader as documented in AGENTS.md (Lifecycle: alert at two failures or lastPublished.at older than 26 h); tools/feed/bootstrap.mjs:239-258,392-404; tools/launchd/app.okolos.feed.plist launch line, found by the `seam` tier)

On a conflicting PR, CI does not run for the merge ref, so 'once CI is green' never comes. The hook's trace is promised without its condition. The documents say feed.log keeps the line 'pre-push: SKIPPED by OKOLOS_SKIP_GATES'. That holds only where core.hooksPath is .githooks: the agent's worktree shares the installing clone's config (set to .githooks on this Mac). When the installing clone is gone, the B-159 bootstrap recovers with `git clone --no-checkout`, which sets no hooksPath, so the push runs no hook and leaves no line. In that case the objects and the remote-tracking ref also land in the recovered clone, not 'the installing clone' AGENTS.md names. (AGENTS.md:150 and the files paragraph near :102; docs/runbooks/feed-signing.md:196; docs/adr/0017-*.md point 8 ('that notice is the trace the escape promises'); tools/feed/bootstrap.mjs:175, found by the `product` tier)

The 'a week for a person' window depends on when the stack lands, and the stack is waiting on an operator decision. sw-06 is built on sw-05 (B-159), whose certification N-103 is parked waiting for the operator (B-159 row). The step first runs one agent run after this reaches origin/main. If that is later than about 2026-11-02T09:08Z the week shrinks, and after about 2026-11-09T09:08Z the PR cannot arrive before main's gate turns red. Nothing reads the record either (OBS-32), so a waiting PR shows only to a person who runs --status. (docs/README.md:18 ('в течение недели'); AGENTS.md:157-167; docs/adr/0017-*.md Цена; docs/backlog.md B-159, found by the `product` tier)
